title: UPT/Higgs Minimal Benchmark — Z2-Symmetric Real Singlet Portal
status: archive-generated minimal calculable descendant of the recovered UPT skeleton; conventional BSM benchmark, not recovered Tim-authored historical math
purpose: Give Unified Potato Theory one deliberately small, solvable particle-physics benchmark before adding nonlocal operators, extra gauge sectors, higher dimensions or cross-scale biology. The benchmark asks whether the recovered Potato-field/Higgs idea can survive ordinary field-theory consistency and present Higgs constraints in its simplest form.
why_promising: This branch has a direct interface with established particle physics: a real scalar singlet coupled through the Higgs portal is mathematically standard, has a finite parameter set, possesses clear correspondence limits and produces collider/cosmological observables. It therefore provides a real falsification ladder for the broader UPT idea.
epistemic_boundary: Success of this benchmark would support only a viable extra scalar sector. It would not by itself validate UPT's nonlocal operator, U(1)_potato, Z6, quantum-gravity sectors, consciousness claims or Potatoverse theology.

model.field_content: Standard Model + one real gauge-singlet scalar P
model.vacuum_assumption: =0 so Z2 remains unbroken; electroweak symmetry breaks normally with H=(0,(v+h)/sqrt(2))^T

after_electroweak_symmetry_breaking.correspondence_limit: lambda_HP -> 0 decouples P from observable Higgs physics; large positive m_P decouples the singlet kinematically at low energy.
after_electroweak_symmetry_breaking.stability_at_large_field: For V_4=lambda_H(H^dagger H)^2+(lambda_HP/2)P^2(H^dagger H)+(lambda_P/4)P^4, a simple tree-level boundedness condition is lambda_H>0, lambda_P>0 and lambda_HP>-2 sqrt(lambda_H lambda_P). Running couplings can modify the high-scale conclusion.

higgs_invisible_channel.partial_width: Gamma(h->PP)=lambda_HP^2 v^2/(32 pi m_h) sqrt(1-4 m_P^2/m_h^2)
higgs_invisible_channel.branching_fraction: BR_inv = Gamma(h->PP)/(Gamma_SM + Gamma(h->PP)) if P is detector-invisible/stable on detector scales
higgs_invisible_channel.illustrative_constraint_translation: Using the published ATLAS full Run-1+Run-2 benchmark BR_inv<0.11 at 95% CL and Gamma_SM about 4.07 MeV gives lambda_HP roughly below 0.010 in the light-P limit. This is an illustrative conversion, not claimed as the latest global 2026 combination.
higgs_invisible_channel.derived_limit_formula: For a chosen BR limit B and SM width Gamma_SM, Gamma_PP,max=[B/(1-B)] Gamma_SM and lambda_HP,max(m_P)=sqrt[32 pi m_h Gamma_PP,max/(v^2 sqrt(1-4m_P^2/m_h^2))].
higgs_invisible_channel.interpretation: The rapid weakening close to m_h/2 is a phase-space effect, not evidence that the portal becomes intrinsically less coupled. Above threshold the invisible decay closes and other observables must carry the constraint.
higgs_invisible_channel.scientific_value: This immediately removes large parts of parameter space if P is light and stable, making the model genuinely constrainable rather than infinitely adjustable.

nested_model_strategy.M1: Standard Model + local Z2 singlet P as defined here
nested_model_strategy.M2: M1 plus a precisely defined nonlocal/fractional kinetic operator K(Box/Lambda^2)
nested_model_strategy.rule: Do not jump directly from M0 to the full historical UPT master action. First establish whether M1 is mathematically/phenomenologically viable. Add M2 only if it predicts something not already captured by M1 and a causal/unitary prescription exists in the claimed regime.

what_can_be_explained_if_viable: An additional invisible/exotic Higgs decay channel when kinematically open.
A stable scalar dark-sector candidate if the Z2 is exact and cosmological assumptions are added and tested.
A controlled portal through which a previously hidden scalar sector communicates with Standard Model matter.
A clean baseline against which any genuinely UPT-specific nonlocal term must demonstrate added explanatory or predictive value.
what_it_does_not_explain_yet: Why alpha=1.3 in the recovered fractional kinetic term.
Why U(1)_potato x Z6 should be the historical symmetry.
Biological or neural self-organization across scales.
next_calculations: Map (m_P,lambda_HP,lambda_P) tree-level viability including boundedness and perturbativity.
Replace the illustrative BR_inv benchmark with the strongest appropriate current combined experimental likelihood when doing a real fit.
For m_P>m_h/2 use Higgs precision, off-shell/exotic-scalar and cosmological/direct-detection constraints only under the assumptions relevant to those analyses.
If P is a dark-matter candidate, compute thermal or nonthermal abundance rather than assuming the observed relic density.
Only after the local model is controlled, replace the canonical kinetic operator with a rigorously specified UPT kernel and quantify the observable difference.
failure_conditions: No parameter region satisfies the stability/phenomenology assumptions required for the interpretation being claimed.
The scalar sector is viable but has no distinctive role beyond a generic Higgs-portal singlet; in that case it remains a useful baseline but not evidence for broader UPT structure.
A proposed nonlocal extension introduces unacceptable poles, instabilities or causal ambiguities in its claimed EFT regime.
Additional complexity fails to improve any predeclared observable or explanatory compression over the local singlet baseline.
